Chapter 6640: Not Right

Chapter 6640: Not Right

As the water of fortune rained on Heaven World, everyone found this liquid to be heavenly. Purified rays emanated from them, opening their veins and meridians. Their state reached its highest.

Cultivators’ vitality and power soared like a boat on rising tides. The elderly became younger again; the sickly found their illness disappearing without using any medicine...

Even emperors and above found their dao power increasing dramatically. Their heavenly gaze became accurate and more insightful. They gained the confidence to reach the overlord realm or even higher - something utterly ridiculous.

Earlier, Grand Preceptor and the others had risked their lives for the spring. Now, liquid flowed freely to all of Heaven World.

The precious material became available to everyone. Would everyone gain more lifespan and cultivation improvement?

“A blessing from above?” Mortals stretched their hands up and rejoiced.

“Impossible.” A primal ancestor whispered: “This will deplete an overlord’s everything.”

They understood what was going on and could do so on a smaller scale. Why would an overlord sacrifice himself for this purpose?

They looked around and saw Dugu Yuan’s group with a heavy expression.

“Boom!” World Seal’s area of effect included an identical Three Immortals World.

Everyone looked up and saw how it was brimming with life and looked so real.

“Not good!” The apex primal ancestors became alarmed.

World Seal could copy Three Immortals but not its plentiful life force. This life force came from countless existences unavailable to the treasure. Something must be wrong.

“Buzz.” The copied world pulsed brightly like a galaxy full of stars. Those bathed in the liquid also glowed.

They glowed initially but this new glow was harmonizing with whatever was going on above. Suddenly, the liquid locked them together with Three Immortals.

“Becoming one with World Seal.” Dugu Yuan looked up and blurted.

Deeper in a hidden location, many pairs of eyes opened.

“Brat, there’s a limit to this game or the master will kill you before I do.” One overlord’s expression darkened.

Most living beings felt themselves melting and becoming one with everything else. However, this wasn’t a bad feeling at all since they brimmed with power and vitality.

Alas, the primal ancestors and heaven-slayers wanted no part in this.

“Lord of All Things.” Light God recalled the title: “Li Xingchen wants to become one with everything.”

Those nearby froze in confusion.

“So this is bad?” An emperor asked about the ominous development.

“Both. You all will obtain fortunes but are tied with Li Xingchen.” Grand Preceptor said.

“In other words, sharing his fortunes and perils.” Dugu Yuan added.

“That doesn’t sound too bad? Appears to be a blessing.” One desolate god said.
